description:
Convert rsID to variant_id format for use with get_variant_annotation.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table variant — one record = one variant (chromosome, position, reference and alternate allele).
Key: variantId.
Arguments: rs_id accepts rsid (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Variants of OT 25.09 (existence only).
one rsID can name several alleles; every matching variant is returned (more than one is reported as ambiguous by the resolver)

rs_id.description: Accepts rsid; resolved to one rsid (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
